summary: AtlasClear Holdings filed an 8-K solely to supplement its definitive proxy statement for the May 27, 2026 annual meeting. The supplement corrects the quorum threshold to 33.3% of voting power and clarifies that only 590,046 shares remain reserved under the 2024 Equity Incentive Plan after a 1-for-60 reverse split. No transaction, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation is disclosed. The filing is a routine proxy correction with no event triggering a special-situations classification.
